headline: Nikkei Falls 5% on Losses at Technology Companies
summary: Japan's Nikkei index fell about five percent, led by sharp losses in technology stocks after media reports about troubled debts at US cloud computing company CoreWeave. Concerns about US interest rate hikes also weighed.
why: The Nikkei 225 is Japan's benchmark stock index, heavily weighted toward large export and technology companies. CoreWeave is a US provider of cloud computing capacity for AI workloads.

impacts.name: CoreWeave
impacts.why: Media reports about troubled debts at CoreWeave were cited as a trigger for the technology sell-off.
